svg.title: Cartographer: a coverage-gated loop, not a questionnaire
svg.text: Cartographer: a coverage-gated loop, not a questionnaire
Every unknown is a priced row; the gate decides when building may start, and the floor decides who must confirm.
Depth is announced first; it sets breadth:
Clearing loop — a router, not an interview
Route — how the row gets cleared
answer lives in the user’s head
read code or data; never ask
shown so the user can steer
↻ repeat until the gate passes or the user exits
resolved, or deferred with a default
✓ completeness critic runs before any PASS
for the user; exits never waive it.
next steps are offered, never taken
a check must be able to fail
check files locked against the implementer
offered after the spec · spec + contract approved
Quiz is generated from the ledger, one question
Merge only if no open row has regret ≥ 1.0 and
